summary: TeamNest.ai Phase 2 full backend + frontend testing complete. Backend: 54/54 tests pass (35 regression + 19 new for uploads/file-download/share-snapshot/real-AI). Frontend: all 11 critical flows verified — rebrand to teamnest.ai (yellow TN logo), demo-login, dashboard stats, sidebar nav, group chat messaging, Ask AI (make_professional → apply), Research with 3 models (real responses from chatgpt/claude/gemini), Share snapshot → public /s/{token} loads WITHOUT auth, file upload + download chip, Projects (5 folders + detail), Tasks (5-column kanban + new-task creation), Team Admin (5 members + invite modal).

ui_bugs.issue: Emergent badge (id="emergent-badge", 'Made with Emergent' link) overlays the Send button and Ask N model(s) submit button at bottom-right. In Playwright automation it intercepted pointer events and we had to hide it. On real user setups it overlaps visually in the same corner and may catch clicks on narrow viewports.

action_items: Consider raising the chat composer container above the Emergent badge (z-index) or adding right-padding so the Send button sits clear of the bottom-right badge.
server.py is now 1074 lines (was 925) — increasing maintenance debt; split into routes/auth.py, routes/chats.py, routes/ai.py, routes/files.py, routes/snapshot.py, routes/tasks.py modules.
/api/files/{id} reads full file into memory (data, ct = get_object(...)); fine at 20MB cap but consider streaming Response (StreamingResponse with iterator) for fairness under concurrent downloads.

/api/uploads also reads entire file into memory before size check — for a 50MB upload attempt the server has already buffered 50MB before responding 413. Use file.size or check Content-Length header / chunked read.
critical_code_review_comments: Public snapshot endpoint correctly strips voter user IDs from votes (returns only vote_counts) — good privacy practice.
File download endpoint correctly supports both Authorization: Bearer and ?auth= query param so can render images — well-designed.
Cross-workspace file download forbidden (403) verified end-to-end with a fresh signup user — proper isolation.
Share-link create endpoint is idempotent (reuses existing public_token) — good UX, no token churn.
Revoke (DELETE /share) cleanly nulls public_token; subsequent /api/public/snapshot returns 404 — verified.
ALLOWED_EXT whitelist works (rejects .exe with 400) and 20MB cap returns 413 — both verified.
MongoDB _id stripping verified across all new responses (uploads, files, public snapshot thread+responses).
DeepSeek 402 'Payment Required' is gracefully returned as answer text with real=False — meets spec; not a bug.
Iteration 1 regression test had to be updated for brand rename ('teamnest' instead of 'emergent-ai-teams' at root /api/) — semantic change, expected.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_emergent_ai_teams.py (updated: brand rename assertion + relaxed deepseek simulated assertion now that it's real)
test_credentials: Demo accounts /app/memory/test_credentials.md verified — Demo@2026 works; /api/auth/demo-login returns Amit token.
seed_data_creation: No additional seed data needed. Tests use prefix TEST_ for created chats/folders/tasks; uploaded files are real and remain in Emergent object storage (no API to delete files from frontend, but they are scoped to workspace).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both regression suites (test_emergent_ai_teams.py + test_iteration2_features.py) are the canonical backend regression set — run together. New endpoints all pass: POST /api/uploads, GET /api/files/{id} (header or ?auth=), POST/DELETE /api/ai/research/{id}/share, GET /api/public/snapshot/{token}. Perplexity + Grok both return real=True (Perplexity confirmed 'Paris' for capital-of-France test). DeepSeek 402 is EXPECTED. Frontend: Ask AI flow uses data-testid pattern improve-{action} (e.g. improve-make_professional) and apply-improved. AI research model toggles default to all-selected — clicking a toggle DESELECTS rather than selects. Share button (data-testid=share-snapshot-btn) appears on AIComparison panel after responses ready. Public route /s/:token works in fresh tab without auth. Emergent badge in bottom-right needs to be hidden during Playwright automation to click the Send button.
rca of the issue: Minor frontend overlay: 'Made with Emergent' badge (#emergent-badge) is a fixed-position element pinned to bottom-right with high z-index that overlaps the chat composer's Send button and the AI research drawer's submit button. Reproduction: open any group chat, type a message, attempt to click the Send button — at 1920x1080 the badge's hit area partially covers the button. Mitigation suggestions: (1) Increase right padding on .chat-composer to push send button clear of the badge, OR (2) move composer action buttons further left, OR (3) accept it (badge is small enough that ~90% of click area on Send remains).
